messages:
Maria Rivera: heads-up: noticeable spike in request volume to euc3 around 10:12 UTC, provisioner started returning 429/quota_exceeded and heartbeat_timeouts. Scale requests queued.
Aj Chen: seeing the same, dashboard -> provisioner_queue: 118, attach_errors: 72 in last 5m. autoscaler appears to stop issuing new launches after 3 retries.
autoscaler-bot: SCALE_EVENT euc3 req_id=abc123 status=backoff retries=3 next_retry=30s
Sophie K: tagging @oncall-sre. Is this a provisioner bug or cloud-side capacity? I can start shifting traffic if needed :warning:
Leo Park: started traffic-shift per playbook: `POST /controlplane/v1/shift { "from":"euc3","to":"eu-west2","pct":50 }` — rolling out now.
Maria Rivera: tried manual lease cleanup and forced node provisioning: `kubectl delete lease/provisioner-lock-xy` then `kubectl get pods -n infra` logs showed repeated `heartbeat read timeout` in provisioner.
Aj Chen: network graphs show packet drops between provisioner and cloud provider mgmt API (~40% spike). Possibly provider-side BGP flap. Opening ticket with provider.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-3421 — label: infra.provisioner. Notifying SRE rotations and cloud contacts.
Sophie K: mitigation plan: 1) shift 60% traffic to eu-west2, 2) bump euc3 pool_min to 0 to avoid new launches, 3) enable cross-region fallback for new requests. I'll run 1 and 2 now.
Leo Park: increased eu-west2 reserved pool by +6 gpus (manual override) to absorb load. :thumbsup:
Aj Chen: pushed quick fix to provisioner to increase heartbeat timeout and add jitter to retry backoff (PR #4858). Requesting canary deploy to euc3.
Maria Rivera: canary deploy started. Watching attach_errors — dropping from 72 -> 18 in next 5m.
oncall-sre: note: cost impact estimate initial: +8 reserved GPUs for ~3h. Please include in incident notes.
autoscaler-bot: SCALE_EVENT euc3 req_id=abc123 status=resolved after canary; backlog drained.
Sophie K: keep routing rules for 30m, then gradually shift back. We'll follow up with postmortem — suspected root cause: provisioner connection saturation when provider control plane had transient packet loss leading to lease staleness and eviction mismatch.
Maria Rivera: thanks team. After action items: provider ticket updates, add more observability on provisioner sockets, and run a load test to reproduce. I'll file the postmortem template.
Aj Chen: adding a test to simulate control-plane packet loss and ensure autoscaler backoff logic tolerates it.
Leo Park: :thumbsup: good call. Closing interim incident once all metrics stable.
